budgetPolicy: One attempt per task, wall-clock bounded, no automatic model retries; token/cost caps are not currently enforced by OpenInspect. Formal multi-round run requires a separately measured budget profile.
cacheCondition: Fresh containers, cached task/runtime image, shared downloaded layers; Docker/execd/OS caches retained. Scoring runs after model containers are collected and removed.
protocol: OpenInspect parent may inspect both requirements, coordinate two independent children, edit/integrate and validate. Original CooperBench child-patch merge score and parent integration score are reported separately. Parent adds model budget; results are not official peer-cooperation leaderboard runs.
supplementPurpose: One additional attempt each for original 003, 005, 016, 030; preserve the original 30-attempt cohort. Only DSPy has a separately recorded memory increase after confirmed OOM. No best-of selection or automatic retries until success.
